gte.708235A0CFA41C29.quests.09D8C672BB49: How do I build a multiblock structure without instructions?
Hold down the U key on a multiblock host (such as an electric blast furnace) and select the multi-block structure information on the JEI page to obtain this multi-block
Then prepare the materials and place the main unit. Hold the handheld terminal and press Shift+right-click on the main unit. The multi-block structure will take shape.

Please note: There are many ways to build a multiblock structure. The automatically built multi-block structure may not be what you need. You may need to make minor adjustments, such as adding input and output silos.

Input bus, output bus, input assembly, output assembly, energy silo, maintenance silo. The same multiblock structure may have different levels, and different levels of multiblock structures may require different structure blocks. For more questions, please watch the tutorial video about GregTech Modern multiblock structures. The GregTechEasy team also welcomes new users to ask questions through various channels.

gte.tier_1_lv.quests.52D28804938B0A72.de: If you do not follow these safety instructions, there is a high probability that your machine and base will be destroyed in an explosion.
Rule 1: Do not light a fire near a machine; it will cause it to explode.
Second: Be sure to use cables of the correct specifications. For example, if your machine generates a total of 3A LV power, but you use 1x tin cable, your cable will catch fire.
Third: Pay attention to the input voltage of the machine.
If your machine inputs LV voltage, do not apply voltage above LV, otherwise the machine will explode immediately!
Additional information: Our GregTech machines are now waterproof and will not explode even if they are exposed to rain.
gte.tier_1_lv.quests.76E0E419612C082E.de: With the Wireless Network, you no longer have to worry about wiring your machines. For multi-block generators, use a Wireless Power Pod to send power to the Wireless Network.
For single block generators, use a Wireless Power Socket to receive power from single-block generators.

If a multiblock machine needs to be powered by a wireless network, use a wireless energy tank. For a single-block machine, For devices with this level, use a wireless energy receiver of the corresponding level.

A wireless energy receiver can also be attached to the device's casing. Please remember electrical safety and avoid attaching a high-level wireless energy receiver to a low-level device. This can cause a massive explosion.

The Yin-Yang branches have reached another sky. Welcome to UEV! This time, we will turn a tree into an entire circuit factory.

Bootstrap UEV components and water equipment with Super String Mainframes or Yin-Yang Computers as UEV circuits. Yin-Yang Mainframes supply the UIV circuits needed by your first Imaginary machines. You can start before making Imaginary circuits!

Upgrade from UHV Eight Trigmas technology to Super Fusion II, Yin-Yang Fusion Alloy and UEV Machine Casings alongside three-stage water purification. Then build Imaginary construction materials, wafer lithography, board fabrication and circuit integration. The four Imaginary circuits are rated UHV, UEV, UIV and UXV, and all are produced at UEV voltage.
The familiar five components have another upgrade! Combine UHV components with Dark Fluid, Super String Catalyst, Neutronium and Yin-Yang materials in an Assembly Line.
Make motors first, then pistons, pumps and conveyors, followed by robot arms. Pumps build the water plant and robot arms build Imaginary equipment, so automate them early.
UEV emitters, sensors and field generators are essential for water control hatches and Imaginary construction materials. They upgrade UHV components without requiring Imaginary products.
Super String Mainframes or Yin-Yang Computers can still supply the UEV circuits. Switch to your own Imaginary Processor Assemblies once the line is running.
Yin, Yang, runes, Gen/Dui chips and elemental symbol papers remain important. The Red Sun Tao Core makes Imaginary Glass and Growth Medium; the Kun-Gen Star Hub makes Imaginary Core Casings and Coils.

Yin-Yang Mainframes are both UIV circuits and a specific ingredient of Imaginary Core Casings. A generic UIV circuit cannot replace that ingredient. Supply both older machines with enough voltage to process UEV recipes.
Electronic-grade Purified Water is the lifeline of this factory. Build the central plant first using conventional casings, UEV pumps, UEV circuits, Water Symbol Papers and Distilled Water. No Imaginary materials are required.

The plant supplies power and parallel limits; purification units have no energy hatches. Sneak-right-click the plant with a Data Stick to copy its coordinates, then right-click each unit controller to link it. Pipe water and reagents separately.
The old Ultrapure Water Refinery is retired. Use the plant and three purification stages. Start with low parallel settings and expand when power and reagents can keep up.
React Aluminium Dust, Iron Dust, Hydrochloric Acid and Distilled Water at IV to make Composite Flocculant. Provide room for the Hydrogen byproduct.
T1 uses 50 mB flocculant per 1000 mB raw water, or 25 mB per 1000 mB Distilled Water. Check this task after setting up a steady reagent supply.
Use Carbon Dust, Silicon Dioxide Dust and Sulfuric Acid in a LuV Chemical Reactor to make Modified Carbon Microspheres, with Diluted Sulfuric Acid as a byproduct.
Every T1 batch consumes one bead; these are consumables. Automate their supply alongside the flocculant.
T1 needs a Thermal Control Hatch and Thermal Signal Hatch. Connect the signal hatch front to the control hatch: redstone heats and no signal cools, both at 2 degrees C per second.
The target changes every 60 seconds of operation, with a permitted band of +/-5 degrees C. The signal hatch keeps a +/-1 degree C buffer around the center. Wire the feedback for reliable control.
T1 produces Distilled Purified Water from water, flocculant and carbon beads. Both raw-water and Distilled Water routes work. Link the unit to the central plant first.

Yield starts low and reaches 100%% after 600 seconds of continuous stable operation. More than 15 seconds outside the temperature band triggers a maintenance fault; idle time also resets stable progress. Keep reagents stocked and outputs clear.
At full T1 yield, 1000 mB raw water gives 900 mB Distilled Purified Water. Distilled Water gives 1000 mB while consuming less flocculant.
This water builds and feeds T2 and makes EDI regeneration reagent. Reserve a branch for that reagent. Actual output also depends on T1 thermal yield. Check this task after producing water.
T2 accepts Ozone or Hydrogen Peroxide. An IV Electrolyzer turns 3000 mB Oxygen into 2000 mB Ozone; Hydrogen Peroxide comes from your existing chemical line.

A batch uses 800 mB Distilled Purified Water and 50 mB oxidant to produce 800 mB UV Purified Water and 25 mB Oxygen. Peroxide has a shorter base duration, but still needs its full UV dose. Check after establishing either oxidant supply.
Give Every Drop Its UV Dose
T2 accepts one to four UV Lamp Hatches. More lamps deliver dose faster, and the controller offers 25%%, 50%%, 75%% or 100%% power.
Watch dose progress when raising plant parallels. Processing takes longer if lamps cannot keep up. Lamp power still comes from the central plant.
Use T1 water to assemble the UV-Oxidation Unit, install lamp hatches and link it to the plant. Your waterworks are starting to look futuristic!
Use either Ozone or Hydrogen Peroxide; both make UV Purified Water. Handle the Oxygen byproduct so the output does not stall.
You now have T3 construction fluid and feed water. UV Purified Water still needs EDI treatment to reach the quality required by Imaginary production.
T3 consumes it in both production and regeneration. Buffer it between T2 and T3 to prevent regeneration from running dry. Check after producing it.
Make Mixed Bed Resin Beads from Sodium Hydroxide, Styrene, Toluene, Sulfuric Acid and Ammonia at ZPM. A Chemical Reactor works; an Integrated Petrochemical Plant offers better batch output.
T3 production consumes one bead per batch. Handle the Diluted Sulfuric Acid byproduct and keep the plant stocked.
Combine Sodium Hydroxide, Hydrochloric Acid and T1 Distilled Purified Water in a LuV Chemical Reactor to make Electronic Acid-Base Reagent. Ordinary Distilled Water is not a substitute.
T3 uses 20 mB per production batch and 1 mB per regeneration batch. Check after establishing a steady supply so a full membrane does not stop the factory.
Install an EDI Load Signal Hatch and Regeneration Control Hatch. The load hatch outputs strength 0-15; any signal at the control hatch requests regeneration, and no signal requests production.

Use high and low thresholds with a latch: start regeneration near full load, then return to production at low load. Directly wiring raw load switches too early. The machine does not choose thresholds for you.
The EDI unit uses UV Purified Water, regeneration reagent and resin beads to make 800 mB Electronic-grade Purified Water per batch. Link it to the plant and wire its regeneration control.

Membrane capacity is 1,200,000 mB of load. Production increases load; a regeneration batch consumes 100 mB UV water and 1 mB reagent to clear up to 800 mB load. Regeneration produces no water and uses no resin. Modes change at batch boundaries.
All three stages are working! Imaginary cores, glass, growth medium, leaves, crystal growth, lithography and fabrication all need this final water grade.
Keep the T1 reagent branch and buffers before T3 and after the final output. Complete a production-regeneration-production cycle before checking this task. Your Imaginary Tree can finally be watered.
Assemble Eight Trigmas Casings, Neutronium Plates, a UEV Pump, Yin/Yang and UEV circuits with Soldering Alloy and Naquadria to make 32 Imaginary Casings.
This recipe needs no purified water, so work on it alongside the water plant. Stock these casings for the tree and both dedicated factories.
Combine Imaginary Casings with Neutronium Frames, Tritanium Long Rods, a UEV Piston, Xun Runes and Yin/Yang in the Assembly Line.
Branch Casings form the trunk and branches and are also used by the lithography center and fabricator. Stock them before building.
Upgrade Yin-Yang Field Restriction with Imaginary Casings, Neutronium Plates, a UEV Field Generator, Kun/Qian Runes, Soldering Alloy and Naquadria.
Containment Casings are structural blocks and ingredients for cores, controllers and Imaginary Mainframes. Stable containment supports the next steps.
Assemble Imaginary Energy Conduits from Imaginary Casings, Hex Europium Wire, a UEV Emitter, Yin-Yang Circuit Chips and Zhen Runes.
These conduits are multiblock structure blocks. Machines still need energy or laser hatches for their actual power supply.
A New Core from Yin-Yang Mainframes
The Kun-Gen Star Hub combines Imaginary/Containment Casings, Yin-Yang Mainframes, UEV field generators and sensors, and Gen/Dui chips with Electronic-grade Purified Water to make Core Casings.
A batch consumes two Yin-Yang Mainframes and makes four cores. Bootstrap the first tree with the previous generation; lithography, fabrication and Imaginary Computers also consume these cores.
Upgrade Yin-Yang Coils with Europium Fine Wire, Neutronium Plates, Li/Kan Runes and a UEV Field Generator in the Kun-Gen Star Hub.
This recipe uses Naquadria and Soldering Alloy without purified water. Stock coils for the tree controller and both dedicated factories.
The Red Sun Tao Core processes Laminated Glass, Silicon Dioxide, Yin/Yang and Qian Runes with Electronic-grade Purified Water and Helium into Imaginary Glass. The Yin-Yang Glass Lens is reusable.
Glass is used in all three Imaginary machine structures and in Leaf Matrices. Keep the lens for lithography.
Use Silicon Dust, Yin/Yang, Wood/Water Symbol Papers and Electronic-grade Purified Water in the Red Sun Tao Core to make 32 Imaginary Growth Medium.
Growth Medium is a renewable consumable for crystal growth and boards. Leaf Matrices are permanent structure blocks. Keep the two supplies separate.
The Assembly Line combines Imaginary Glass, Branch Casings, Growth Medium and Xun/Zhen Runes with Electronic-grade Purified Water and Naquadria into a full stack of Leaf Matrices.
The canopy needs many leaves. Check the structure preview before stocking materials. This task checks one sample batch, not the complete tree bill of materials.
Build the tree controller in the Assembly Line using Imaginary construction blocks, UEV components and UIV circuits. Use Yin-Yang Mainframes for the first one and research the Core Casing.

The controller is only the start: the complete structure needs many casings, glass and leaves. Follow the JEI preview and supply UEV power. The tree grows crystals, slices wafers and integrates final circuits; dedicated machines handle lithography and fabrication.
Feed the tree 64 Silicon Dust, four Growth Medium, 1000 mB Naquadria and 4000 mB Electronic-grade Purified Water to grow four Imaginary Tree Boules.
This starts the semiconductor line. Keep the water plant and Growth Medium supply running continuously.
The tree slices one boule into 16 Imaginary Wafers using Lubricant and Electronic-grade Purified Water.
Split wafers into two lines: exposed wafers to Circuit Chips, and raw chips to engraved chips to CPU Chips. You need both for complete circuits.
Research an ordinary Imaginary Wafer to assemble the Lithography Center. Its controller uses UIV circuits, Imaginary construction blocks and UEV emitters/sensors, without requiring its own chip products.
This center handles both chip branches. Every step consumes Electronic-grade Purified Water. Keep a Yin-Yang Glass Lens in its input for reusable exposure and engraving.
Expose Imaginary Wafers in the Lithography Center with the reusable lens, Electronic-grade Purified Water and Hydrogen Peroxide to make Imaginary CPU Wafers.
Despite the name, this branch is diced into Circuit Chips. Dedicated CPU Chips come from the engraving branch below.
Dice one exposed CPU Wafer with Lubricant and Electronic-grade Purified Water in the Lithography Center to make 16 Circuit Chips.
The fabricator controller, SoCs and basic processors all consume these chips. Stock them in batches.
The Lithography Center uses Lubricant and Electronic-grade Purified Water to slice one Imaginary Wafer into four Raw Imaginary Chips.
This branch ultimately yields four CPU Chips per wafer, compared with 16 Circuit Chips on the other branch. Reserve enough wafers for CPU production.
Engrave Raw Imaginary Chips with the reusable lens, Electronic-grade Purified Water and Hydrofluoric Acid into Engraved Imaginary Chips.
The chips still need interconnects before becoming CPUs. Supply Hydrofluoric Acid here, separately from the peroxide exposure branch.
Finish engraved chips in the Lithography Center with Europium Fine Wire, Soldering Alloy and Electronic-grade Purified Water to obtain Imaginary CPU Chips.
Both chip branches are now ready. Reserve four CPU Chips for the fabricator controller and use the rest for SoCs and processors.
Research an Imaginary CPU Chip, then assemble the fabricator from both chip types, Imaginary construction blocks, UEV components and UIV circuits.
It makes boards, printed boards and SoCs. Final circuits are integrated in the tree. Complete lithography first so factory construction does not depend on its own products.
The fabricator combines Reinforced Epoxy Plates, Growth Medium and Europium Foil with Polybenzimidazole and Electronic-grade Purified Water into four Circuit Boards.
Growth Medium supports both crystal growth and board production. Keep it stocked to feed the printing step.
Use Europium Foil, Gold Foil, Iron III Chloride and Electronic-grade Purified Water to turn boards into Printed Circuit Boards in the fabricator.
Printed boards feed both SoCs and basic processors. Split the output between those lines so neither starves the other.
Package Both Chips into a SoC
The fabricator combines two CPU Chips, four Circuit Chips and one printed board with Europium Fine Wire, Soldering Alloy and Electronic-grade Purified Water into two SoCs.
SoCs are required by UEV Processor Assemblies. They are intermediate components, not finished tier-tagged circuits.
The First Processors on the Branches
Back in the tree, combine a printed board, four CPU Chips, eight Circuit Chips and Tritanium Fine Wire with Soldering Alloy and Electronic-grade Purified Water to make four Processors.
These are UHV circuits, made at UEV voltage. Their lower circuit rating is the starting point for the next three grades.
The tree combines four Processors and four SoCs with Neutronium Plates, Soldering Alloy and Electronic-grade Purified Water into two Processor Assemblies.
These are finished UEV circuits. Use them in UEV components and water equipment in place of the older Super String Mainframes or Yin-Yang Computers.
The tree combines four Processor Assemblies, one Core Casing, Neutronium Plates and Soldering Alloy into an Imaginary Computer.

It is a UIV circuit and can replace Yin-Yang Mainframes in generic UIV inputs for the tree, lithography center and fabricator. Keep the older line for Core Casings, which specifically require Yin-Yang Mainframes.
A Mainframe for the Whole Tree
Combine four Imaginary Computers, two Containment Casings, Neutronium Plates and Soldering Alloy in the tree to make an Imaginary Mainframe. All four circuit grades are complete!

It is a UXV circuit produced at UEV voltage. Besides packing it as a universal UXV circuit, Mainframes are specific ingredients for two new multiblock controllers. Put the completed line to work expanding itself.
Use four Imaginary Mainframes, Imaginary construction blocks and UEV components in the Assembly Line to build the Growth Array controller; research a Mainframe. These Mainframes are consumed as specific machine ingredients, not replaceable with generic UXV circuits.

Its 19x13x11 twin glass towers have exclusive recipes for Growth Medium, Boules and Wafers, with 50%% more output from the same consumables. Third-stage purified water remains required. Follow the structure preview; parts fit the skid and front console.
Use eight Imaginary Mainframes, Imaginary construction blocks, UEV components and SoCs to assemble the Integration Matrix controller, again researching a Mainframe. Mainframes are specific, consumed construction ingredients.

The 17x9x17 energy ring surrounds four compute pylons and takes over all four finished circuit grades. Exclusive batch recipes yield 50%% more from the same consumables. Lithography, boards, SoCs and water remain upstream; the machine operates at UEV.
Feed the Growth Array 32 Silicon Dust, 16 Yin, 16 Yang, four each of Wood/Water Symbol Papers and 8000 mB purified water to make 96 Growth Medium.
The same inputs previously made 64 in the Red Sun Tao Core. Supply more to boule and board production; keep the original line for bootstrap.
The Growth Array consumes 128 Silicon Dust, eight Growth Medium, 2000 mB Naquadria and 8000 mB purified water to grow 12 Boules instead of the ordinary eight.
Expand medium production, grow crystals, then slice them in the array. Mainframes now support the whole upstream Imaginary line.
The Growth Array slices four Boules with 4000 mB Lubricant and 4000 mB purified water into 96 Wafers instead of the ordinary 64.
Feed the extra wafers into both lithography branches. The Mainframe unlocks a dedicated factory while preserving purification and crystal growth.
Matrix: Expand All Four Circuit Grades

Feed lithography and fabrication outputs into the Integration Matrix. Dedicated recipes cover Processors, Assemblies, Computers and Mainframes. The first two retain purified-water inputs; the last two retain core/containment casings, Neutronium and solder.
Two ordinary batches of consumables yield three batches of output: 12 Processors, six Assemblies, three Computers or three Mainframes. Run all four recipes, then complete this sample check.
Congratulations! Yin-Yang materials, three-stage purification, crystal growth, lithography, fabrication, four circuit grades and Mainframe expansion now form a complete Imaginary factory.

Keep Yin-Yang Mainframes, Silicon, Naquadria, Soldering Alloy, Lubricant, Europium materials and water reagents supplied. Allocate wafers between both chip branches. Check after automating supplies and EDI regeneration feedback. Let the tree keep growing!

Keep the 15x15x3 fusion ring, using Eight Trigmas Casings, Fusion Glass and four Yin-Yang Coils. Retain at least 40 Eight Trigmas Casings and install four fluid input hatches, one fluid output hatch and an energy or laser input hatch. Follow the JEI structure preview.

Select the Super Fusion Reactor II recipe type in the controller and supply UHV power to make the new alloy. The machine also supports the original Super Fusion recipes; switch recipe types to continue using the older line.
Feed Super Fusion II 1152 mB Tritanium, 576 mB Neutronium, 1000 mB Fire Element and 1000 mB Water Element. This UHV recipe takes 30 seconds before overclocking and produces 2304 mB Yin-Yang Fusion Alloy per batch, equivalent to 16 ingots.
Cast the alloy into ingots in a Fluid Solidifier with an ingot mold. Super Fusion II supplies this alloy; process it into plates for UEV Machine Casings next.
Shape the Fusion Alloy into Plates
Process Yin-Yang Fusion Alloy Ingots into plates in a Bender or another plate-making machine. Prepare your first eight plates and check JEI for the available recipes.
Each UEV Machine Casing needs eight alloy plates. The next step needs eight casings, or 64 plates in total. Build this alloy line alongside three-stage water purification.
Set a UHV Assembler to circuit 8 and combine one UHV Machine Casing, eight Yin-Yang Fusion Alloy Plates, four Tritanium Plates, four Yin-Yang Circuit Chips and 576 mB Soldering Alloy. The base recipe takes 30 seconds and makes one UEV Machine Casing.
Prepare eight UEV Machine Casings for the next batch of 32 Imaginary Casings. This step still uses UHV power and needs no Imaginary circuits. UEV Machine Hulls also use these casings.
